fprintargs stdout right
cmp want stdout
! cmp wrong stdout
cmpenv want stdout

fprintargs stderr right
cmp want stderr
! cmp wrong stderr
cmpenv want stderr

# cmpenv still expands only the second argument, including captured output.
env VALUE=right
fprintargs stdout '$VALUE'
cmpenv want stdout
fprintargs stdout right
! cmpenv variable stdout

# The diff follows argument order when captured output is second.
unquote scripts/testscript.txt
! testscript scripts
stdout '(?m)^-wrong$'
stdout '(?m)^\+right$'

-- want --
right
-- wrong --
wrong
-- variable --
$VALUE
-- scripts/testscript.txt --
>fprintargs stdout right
>cmp want stdout
>
>-- want --
>wrong
